decision_rationale: The record presents a new multimodal generative framework, Cell2Text, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. It uses single-cell RNA-seq as the biological modality and generates natural-language descriptions from expression data.
evidence_snippet: "translates scRNA-seq profiles into structured natural language descriptions"; "pairs single-cell gene expression profiles with natural language descriptions"; "combining gene-level embeddings ... with instruction-tuned language models"; "generates interpretable natural language descriptions from single-cell expression data"; "bridging high-dimensional expression profiles with structured biological knowledge"
